hero.headline: Bilingual websites, built right.
hero.subline: We design and build Arabic and English websites and web apps with real right-to-left layouts and proper Arabic typography. No machine translation, no broken mirrors.

problem.headline: Most Arabic websites are English sites, flipped.
problem.card1Body: Arrows pointing the wrong way, menus opening from the wrong side, numbers out of order.
problem.card2Body: Tiny or distorted Arabic, because the site was designed around a Latin font.
problem.card3Body: Sentences no Arabic speaker checked before they went live.
problem.closing: Arabic-speaking customers notice in seconds, and they leave.

process.headline: From first message to live site, in 4 steps.
process.step1Body: A short free call to understand your business, your customers and what the site needs to do.
process.step2Body: You see both the Arabic and English designs before any code is written.
process.step3Body: We build it, you test it on a private link and ask for changes.
process.step4Body: We connect your domain, go live, and stay on if you want ongoing care.

about.headline: Behind every site, someone who speaks your language.
about.bio: I'm Anan Kherbek, founder of Yameen Yasar Studio. Based in Malaysia, studying Computer Science with a focus on AI. I live in Arabic and English every day, and I know how much it shows when a website respects both.
about.closing: When you work with us, you talk to the person building your site, not a sales team.

faq.headline: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Bank transfer, PayPal or Wise. 50% to start, 50% before launch.
faq.q2: What if I don't like the design?
faq.a2: Every package includes revision rounds, and we refine until it's right within the package scope.
faq.a3: You give us the information and we shape it. If you want Arabic copy written from scratch, add the copywriting add-on.
faq.q4: Do I need a domain and hosting?
faq.a4: No. We help you buy the domain in your name, and hosting is free for simple sites.
faq.a5: Yes. The domain, the code and the content are all yours.
faq.q6: Do you work with clients outside the Gulf?
faq.a6: Yes, we work online with clients anywhere.
